zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.arrival.title: 果糕逻辑
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.arrival.descripti: 从蛋糕门出发，探索表界、里界与果糕地府。
zh_cn.message.guogaology.guide:
§b果糕逻辑§r
门框：5×5 去四角，中间空 3×3，共十二格。
主世界：完整蛋糕（可混用果糕）＋苹果 → 大数表界。
表界→里界：12 个 ω／ε／Γ／Ω 结晶块，可自由混搭；扔入 1 份 Ω 序数结晶。
里界→地府：12 个任意颜色果糕方块，扔入 1 个果糕方块。
返程：表界归途框＝4 圆石＋1 任意木板；里界归途框＝4 序数晶屑＋1 任意木板；冥林归途框＝4 果糕冥土＋1 冥杉木板；每次得 1 块。同种归途框摆十二格，投入 1 张归途签（1 任意木板在上、1 木棍在下）返回上一层；三种框架不能混搭。
水平距离 主世界:表界:里界:地府 = 1:1:4:16。
里界坠入虚空进入地府 Y=500；地府四分之一重力、无摔落伤害。
管理员指令与材料包：/guogaology help。
zh_cn.mining.guogaology.effect.8: 仅供手稿：攻防、恢复与延时
zh_cn.message.guogaology.missing_dimension: 目的地尚未载入，请保存并重新打开世界。

zh_cn.modmenu.summaryTranslation.guogaology: 三层大数世界、序数矿物、巨构与晶核强化。
zh_cn.modmenu.descriptionTranslation.guogaolog: 探索自然尺度的大数表界、巨构林立的大数里界与果糕地府。开采四档序数矿物，以晶核强化装备和副手扽西手稿，并遇见表界的七类普通生物。

zh_cn.tooltip.guogaology.lho_glass: 近乎透明的空境玻璃，一碰就碎，什么也不会留下。
zh_cn.tooltip.guogaology.stellar_stone: 半透明的星空，仿佛把一小片夜空握在手里。

zh_cn.mining.guogaology.manuscript_drag_hint: 手稿留在手中 · 拖动晶核镶嵌

zh_cn.mining.guogaology.bow_pierce: 穿透：每箭最多命中两个生物
zh_cn.mining.guogaology.bow_ammo: 特殊箭每轮消耗一个，仅中央箭保留效果
zh_cn.mining.guogaology.manuscript.button_hint: 编辑副手手稿；关闭页面后生效
zh_cn.mining.guogaology.manuscript.socket_tote: 致命伤害时消耗一个；关闭镶嵌页后生效

zh_cn.command.guogaology.kit.outer: 领取十二个蛋糕与一个苹果
zh_cn.command.guogaology.kit.inner: 领取四档结晶块各三个与一份 Ω 序数结晶
zh_cn.command.guogaology.kit.underworld: 领取十二个果糕门框材料与一个激活用果糕
zh_cn.command.guogaology.kit.return: 领取当前维度的十二个归途框与一张归途签
zh_cn.command.guogaology.admin_note: 传送与材料指令需要管理员权限。点击指令可填入聊天栏。
zh_cn.command.guogaology.unavailable: 暂时无法准备传送，请稍后重试。
zh_cn.command.guogaology.kit_given: 已领取前往%s的完整建门材料。
zh_cn.command.guogaology.return_kit_given: 已领取当前维度的完整返程材料。
zh_cn.lamp.guogaology.input_hint: 放入同色果糕灯，选择形态
zh_cn.mining.guogaology.enchanted_no_sockets: 已附魔：去除附魔后可镶嵌
zh_cn.mining.guogaology.install.enchanted: 已附魔的装备无法镶嵌
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.enter_outer: 用12个蛋糕摆成水平5×5去四角的门框，向内投入一个苹果激活，再穿门进入表界。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.first_ore.d: 用铁镐或更好的镐获得任一种序数矿物；四种矿都直接掉落材料。
制作或获得一把序数镐、剑或弓。
制作扽西手稿。副手持有时，可从背包里的手稿按钮打开镶嵌界面。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.full_set.de: 备齐头盔、胸甲、护腿与靴子，可以混用四种序数材料。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.number_tool: 在里界采集数字刻石，制作数字石镐或数字石剑；等级取材料数字的平均值向下取整。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.return_read: 备好归途签和归途框。12个同种归途框搭门，投入归途签可返回上一层。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.portal_retu: 亲手投入归途签，激活任一种归途门。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.return_up.d: 从里界返回表界，或从果糕地府返回里界。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.enter_inner: 在表界用12个矿物结晶块搭水平5×5去四角的门框，ω、ε、Γ、Ω可混搭；投入一份Ω材料激活，再穿门进入里界。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.shards.desc: 开采序数晶矿，获得序数晶屑；徒手也能采集，镐更快。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.crystal.des: 四片晶屑合成序数晶体，也能拆回。放置后稳定周围两圈的LHO材料。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.station.des: 制作强化台，可装入或取回晶核；装备附魔和晶核镶嵌互斥。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.socketed.de: 完成一次带晶核的装备或手稿编辑并关闭界面。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.higher_stat: 制作高级强化台，使用二阶晶核。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.ultimate_st: 制作终极强化台，使用三阶晶核。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.ordinal3.de: 序数晶体与序数晶核逐级九合一，获得三级序数晶核；各级均可拆分。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.lamp_shaper: 制作果糕灯塑形台，在两种表情、完整灯与3×3×3分块之间转换。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.compute_set: 在里界收集算力芯片，制作机柜或终端。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.enter_under: 在里界用12个果糕方块搭水平5×5去四角的门框，可混搭颜色；再投入1个果糕方块激活，穿门进入果糕地府。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_ma: 进入矩阵折峰堡的建筑空间，探索它的通路与主题陈列。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_po: 进入迭代圆木塔的建筑空间，探索它的通路与主题陈列。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_hy: 进入六枝冠庭的建筑空间，探索它的通路与主题陈列。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_ab: 进入缺页悬空回廊的建筑空间，探索它的通路与主题陈列。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_we: 进入紫菜三角宫的建筑空间，探索它的通路与主题陈列。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_as: 进入Astra 推演中枢的建筑空间，探索它的通路与主题陈列。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_fr: 进入界限演算庭的建筑空间，探索它的通路与主题陈列。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_gu: 进入果糕终境巨树的建筑空间，探索它的通路与主题陈列。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmarks_a: 进入八种巨构各自的建筑空间；无需开启箱子。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.first_omega: 获得第一份Ω序数结晶或一块Ω矿石。前往里界的矿物门，需要投入一份Ω材料激活。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.ordinal1.de: 九块普通序数晶体凝为一级序数晶核。装入手稿可加强攻击、防护、已有治疗和果糕状态持续时间。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.ordinal2.de: 九合一取得二级序数晶核，继续加强手稿中的综合加成。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_matri: 进入里界的矩阵山脉，寻找本地材料与巨构。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_ma: 从山脉晶页采集矩阵薄片。平面的矩阵，也能展开成立体山脉。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_matrix: 获得1级矩阵晶核。镶入镐可额外开采；装入手稿则同时增加挖速加值和急迫乘区。
获得2级矩阵晶核。更高阶的矩阵扩大额外开采能力，也加强手稿的两项挖速。
获得3级矩阵晶核。将开采能力推进到三级；额外开采不会向选中方块下方延伸。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_power: 进入里界的幂塔荒漠，寻找本地材料与巨构。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_po: 收集箭纹木节与任一种TREE彩色节点，辨认荒漠中箭头、树与图的踪迹。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_power_: 获得1级幂塔晶核。镶入剑、弓或手稿可加强攻击，武器与手稿分别计入。
获得2级幂塔晶核。将攻击晶核推进到二级；同一物品上的同类加成平方求和开根号。
获得3级幂塔晶核。三级幂塔进一步加强攻击，在里界与地府表现为更强的独立乘区。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_hydra: 进入里界的序数花园，寻找本地材料与巨构。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_hy: 采集Hydra芽穗，观察树状分枝；这里的Hydra是景观植物。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_hydra_: 获得1级分枝芽核。镐获得时运II并可切换精准采集；剑对应抢夺，弓对应无限，手稿延长触距。
获得2级分枝芽核。二级提升时运与抢夺，并让弓获得多重射击。
获得3级分枝芽核。三级提供更高时运与抢夺、弓的穿透，或更远的手稿触距。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_absen: 进入里界的LHO 空无之境，寻找本地材料与巨构。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_ab: 普通序数晶体稳定周围两圈，即5×5×5范围；ψ、Z、fffZ、FOS会变色。收集一枚这些材料和一块普通晶体。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_absenc: 获得1级空无晶核。装入手稿后，普通野怪的主动索敌距离缩短；装入装备则保护耐久。
获得2级空无晶核。手稿使普通野怪不再主动索敌，并提供夜视；特殊索敌机制仍保留。
获得3级空无晶核。手稿连普通报复索敌也不再触发；装备上的耐久保护更强。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_weave: 进入里界的紫菜桌高原，寻找本地材料与巨构。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_we: 从紫菜桌景物收集紫菜胶质；留意可弹奏的iBLP图案。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_weaver: 获得1级紫菜凝核。头盔减少耗氧并提供水下速掘，靴子改善水中移动；手稿每4秒治疗。
获得2级紫菜凝核。二级继续加强水下能力；手稿同时提供治疗与饥饿下限保障。
获得3级紫菜凝核。三级头盔不再耗氧，靴子提供更强水中移动；手稿治疗与饥饿保障也升级。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_astra: 进入里界的Astra 推演原，寻找本地材料与巨构。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_as: 收集凝云珠与算力芯片，连接云端扭结与地面的机柜。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_astra_: 获得1级核爆之心。装入剑或弓，命中会对目标与附近生物产生爆裂伤害，不破坏地形。
获得2级核爆之心。二级加强命中的爆裂；核爆之心不适用于手稿。
获得3级核爆之心。三级爆裂更强；多颗同核的爆裂比例平方求和开根号。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_front: 进入里界的界限高原，寻找本地材料与巨构。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_fr: 收集集合膜或纸带端帽，观察集合晶壳与长纸带。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_fronti: 获得1级界限晶核。护甲提供额外防护；手稿降低摔落与撞击伤害、提高安全摔落高度，并增加跳高与步速。
获得2级界限晶核。装入手稿可切换缓速飞行，并获得防火；护甲仍用于防护。
获得3级界限晶核。装入手稿可自由飞行并冲刺；里界与地府的冲刺飞行更快。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_gu: 从地府冥杉景物收集树脂；留意冥林、错层与无穷降链。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_guogao: 获得1级果糕之心。剑与弓使目标缓慢、中毒；手稿增加生命，装备护甲本身不直接加生命。
获得2级果糕之心。武器施加更强负面状态；手稿增加生命、免疫部分状态，并优先使用背包图腾保命。
获得3级果糕之心。三级武器可使目标凋零、虚弱、反胃并有概率失明；手稿强化生命与状态免疫。
双手空着、不潜行，右键一张合法紫菜桌的图案格，实际开始演奏。
zh_cn.advancement.guogaology.guide.omega_maste: 穿戴四件Ω护甲并手持Ω手稿；五件共38槽均镶入兼容的满级晶核。图腾、空槽与未生效的编辑不计。

en_us.advancement.guogaology.arrival.title: Guogaology
en_us.advancement.guogaology.arrival.descripti: Begin with a cake gate and explore the Outer, Inner and Guogao Underworld.
en_us.message.guogaology.guide:
§bGuogaology§r
Ring: twelve blocks in a 5x5 outline without corners; keep the central 3x3 empty.
Overworld: whole cakes (Guogao blocks may be mixed in) + apple -> Outer.
Outer -> Inner: 12 mineral storage blocks, freely mixing omega, epsilon, Gamma and Omega; throw in one Omega mineral.
Inner -> Underworld: 12 Guogao blocks of any color, plus one thrown Guogao block.
Return: 4 cobblestone + 1 plank -> 1 Outer Return Frame; 4 Ordinal Shards + 1 plank -> 1 Inner Return Frame; 4 Guogao Dreadsoil + 1 Dread Fir Plank -> 1 Dread Forest Return Frame. Use any planks where unspecified. Place 12 matching frames and throw in 1 Return Token (1 plank above 1 stick) to return one layer; do not mix frame types.
Horizontal scale Overworld:Outer:Inner:Underworld = 1:1:4:16.
Falling out of Inner reaches Underworld Y=500; quarter gravity, no fall damage.
Operator travel commands and portal kits: /guogaology help.
en_us.mining.guogaology.effect.8: Manuscript only: combat, healing and duration
en_us.message.guogaology.missing_dimension: The destination dimension is unavailable. Save and reopen the world.

en_us.mining.guogaology.manuscript.effect.3: Reduced ordinary targeting; high-grade night vision
en_us.mining.guogaology.manuscript.effect.7: Health, debuff immunity and inventory totems
en_us.mining.guogaology.manuscript.effect.8: Combat, amplified healing and longer Guogao debuffs
en_us.message.guogaology.no_safe_return: No safe return location was found. Clear the exit or ask an administrator.
en_us.mining.guogaology.sneak: Sneak to mine only one block
en_us.tooltip.guogaology.lho_glass: Near-transparent void glass: shatters at a touch and leaves nothing behind.
en_us.tooltip.guogaology.stellar_stone: A translucent patch of night sky in your hand.
en_us.mining.guogaology.manuscript.open: Inventory Book button: socket cores; main-hand right-click also works
en_us.mining.guogaology.bow_native_damage: Arrow damage varies with speed and charge

en_us.command.guogaology.kit.outer: Receive twelve cakes and one apple
en_us.command.guogaology.kit.inner: Receive three blocks of each ordinal tier and one Omega material
en_us.command.guogaology.kit.underworld: Receive twelve Guogao frame blocks and one Guogao activation block
en_us.command.guogaology.kit.return: Receive twelve return frames for this dimension and one return token
en_us.command.guogaology.admin_note: Travel and material commands require operator permission. Click a command to suggest it in chat.
en_us.command.guogaology.already_here: You are already in this dimension.
en_us.command.guogaology.unavailable: Travel cannot be prepared right now. Please try again shortly.
en_us.command.guogaology.no_parent: This dimension has no previous layer.
en_us.command.guogaology.kit_given: Received a complete portal kit for %s.
en_us.command.guogaology.return_kit_given: Received a complete return portal kit for this dimension.
en_us.lamp.guogaology.input_hint: Insert a Guogao lamp and choose its shape
en_us.mining.guogaology.socketed_no_enchantmen: Socketed: remove all contents before enchanting
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.enter_outer: Build a horizontal 5×5 ring of 12 cakes without corners, throw an apple inside to activate it, then enter the Outer realm.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.first_ore.d: Obtain an ordinal mineral with an iron or better pickaxe. All four ores drop usable materials directly.
Craft or obtain an ordinal pickaxe, sword or bow.
Craft a Denxi Manuscript. While it is in your offhand, use the Book button in your inventory to edit it.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.full_set.de: Obtain a helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots; the four ordinal materials may be mixed.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.number_tool: Gather Number Stones in Inner to craft a Number Stone pickaxe or sword. Its digit is the floor of the material digits’ average.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.return_read: Obtain a Return Token and frames. Activate a ring of 12 matching Return Frames with the token to return one realm.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.portal_retu: Throw a Return Token to activate a return gate.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.return_home: Return from the Outer realm to the Overworld.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.return_up.d: Return from Inner to Outer, or from the Guogao Underworld to Inner.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.enter_inner: In Outer, build a horizontal 5×5 ring of 12 mineral blocks without corners, mixing ω, ε, Γ and Ω. Throw one Ω mineral inside, then enter Inner.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.shards.desc: Mine Ordinal Crystal Ore for shards. Hands work; pickaxes are faster.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.crystal.des: Craft an Ordinal Crystal from four shards, or unpack it again. A placed crystal stabilizes nearby LHO materials.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.station.des: Craft an Enhancement Table to insert or recover cores. Enchantments and sockets are mutually exclusive.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.socketed.de: Close an equipment or manuscript editor with a core installed.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.higher_stat: Craft an Advanced Enhancement Table for second-grade cores.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.ultimate_st: Craft an Ultimate Enhancement Table for third-grade cores.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.ordinal3.de: Fuse crystals and Ordinal Cores nine-to-one until reaching an Ordinal Core Lv3; every step is reversible.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.lamp_shaper: Craft a Guogao Lamp Shaper to choose expressions, whole lamps and 3×3×3 exterior tiles.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.compute_set: Collect Compute Chips in Inner and craft a server rack or terminal.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.enter_under: In Inner, build a horizontal 5×5 ring of 12 Guogao blocks without corners; colors may be mixed. Throw one more Guogao block inside, then enter the Guogao Underworld.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_ma: Enter the built space of Matrix Folded Keep and explore its paths and exhibits.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_po: Enter the built space of Iterated Timber Pagoda and explore its paths and exhibits.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_hy: Enter the built space of Six-Branch Crown Court and explore its paths and exhibits.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_ab: Enter the built space of Missing-Page Galleries and explore its paths and exhibits.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_we: Enter the built space of Laver Triangle Palace and explore its paths and exhibits.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_as: Enter the built space of Astra Inference Nexus and explore its paths and exhibits.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_fr: Enter the built space of Boundary Calculus Court and explore its paths and exhibits.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmark_gu: Enter the built space of Guogao Finality Tree and explore its paths and exhibits.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.landmarks_a: Enter the built space of all eight megastructure types; opening chests is not required.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.first_omega: Obtain your first Ω mineral or ore. The mineral gate to Inner requires one Ω mineral as its offering.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.ordinal1.de: Fuse nine base crystals into an Ordinal Core Lv1. In a manuscript it improves attack, protection, existing healing and Guogao effect duration.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.ordinal2.de: Fuse nine-to-one for an Ordinal Core Lv2 and stronger combined manuscript bonuses.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_matri: Enter Matrix Mountains in Inner to discover its materials and megastructure.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_ma: Gather a Matrix Sheet from a mountain page. A flat matrix can unfold into a mountain.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_matrix: Obtain Matrix Core Lv1. Socket into a pick for extra excavation, or a manuscript for flat and multiplicative mining speed.
Obtain Matrix Core Lv2. A stronger matrix expands extra excavation and both manuscript mining bonuses.
Obtain Matrix Core Lv3. Reach third-grade excavation. Extra mining never targets blocks below the selected block.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_power: Enter Power Tower Desert in Inner to discover its materials and megastructure.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_po: Collect an Arrow Knot and any colored TREE node: traces of arrows, trees and graphs in the desert.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_power_: Obtain Power Tower Core Lv1. Socket into a sword, bow or manuscript for attack; weapon and manuscript contributions are separate.
Obtain Power Tower Core Lv2. Advance the attack core to Lv2; matching copies in one carrier use root-sum-squares.
Obtain Power Tower Core Lv3. Third-grade Tower strengthens attack further, with an independent multiplier in the deep realms.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_hydra: Enter Ordinal Garden in Inner to discover its materials and megastructure.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_hy: Gather a Hydra Sprig from branching scenery. These Hydras are plants.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_hydra_: Obtain Hydra Bud Lv1. Picks gain Fortune II and switchable Silk Touch; swords gain Looting, bows Infinity, manuscripts reach.
Obtain Hydra Bud Lv2. Lv2 improves Fortune and Looting and grants bows Multishot.
Obtain Hydra Bud Lv3. Lv3 offers higher Fortune and Looting, bow Piercing, or longer manuscript reach.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_absen: Enter LHO Realm of Absence in Inner to discover its materials and megastructure.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_ab: A base Ordinal Crystal stabilizes two rings: a 5×5×5 area. ψ, Z, fffZ and FOS change color. Obtain one such material and a base crystal.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_absenc: Obtain Absence Core Lv1. In a manuscript, shorten ordinary mob detection range; on equipment, reduce durability consumption.
Obtain Absence Core Lv2. A manuscript prevents ordinary proactive targeting and grants Night Vision; special detection remains.
Obtain Absence Core Lv3. A manuscript also prevents ordinary retaliation targeting; equipment gains stronger wear protection.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_weave: Enter Laver Tablelands in Inner to discover its materials and megastructure.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_we: Collect Laver Gel from table scenery and look for playable iBLP patterns.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_weaver: Obtain Laver Condensation Core Lv1. Helmets reduce oxygen use and grant Aqua Affinity, boots improve underwater movement, manuscripts heal every four seconds.
Obtain Laver Condensation Core Lv2. Lv2 strengthens aquatic benefits; manuscripts combine healing with a minimum food level.
Obtain Laver Condensation Core Lv3. A Lv3 helmet stops oxygen consumption, boots improve swimming further, and manuscripts improve healing and food protection.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_astra: Enter Astra Inference Plains in Inner to discover its materials and megastructure.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_as: Collect a Cloud Pearl and Compute Chip, linking cloud knots with ground-level server racks.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_astra_: Obtain Heart of Nuclear Awe Lv1. In a sword or bow, hits burst against the target and nearby creatures without damaging terrain.
Obtain Heart of Nuclear Awe Lv2. Lv2 strengthens the on-hit burst. Heart of Nuclear Awe cannot be socketed into manuscripts.
Obtain Heart of Nuclear Awe Lv3. Lv3 bursts are stronger; matching burst contributions combine by root-sum-squares.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.biome_front: Enter Boundary Highlands in Inner to discover its materials and megastructure.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_fr: Collect a Set Membrane or Tape Endcap and examine set shells and long Turing tapes.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_fronti: Obtain Boundary Core Lv1. Armor adds protection; manuscripts reduce fall and impact damage, raise safe fall distance, and improve jumping and walking.
Obtain Boundary Core Lv2. In a manuscript, enable slow flight and fire protection; on armor, retain defensive protection.
Obtain Boundary Core Lv3. In a manuscript, gain free flight and sprint; deep-realm sprint flight is faster.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.material_gu: Gather resin from Underworld Dread Fir scenery; explore forests, misaligned strata and descending chains.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.core_guogao: Obtain Heart of Guogao Lv1. Swords and bows apply Slowness and Poison; manuscripts add health, while armor itself adds none.
Obtain Heart of Guogao Lv2. Weapons apply stronger debuffs; manuscripts add health, resist selected effects, and prioritize real inventory Totems.
Obtain Heart of Guogao Lv3. Lv3 weapons inflict Wither, Weakness and Nausea with a chance of Blindness; manuscripts improve health and immunities.
With both hands empty and without sneaking, right-click a valid Laver table pattern to begin playing.
en_us.advancement.guogaology.guide.omega_maste: Wear all four Ω armor pieces and hold an Ω Manuscript. Fill all 38 sockets with compatible maximum-grade cores; Totems, empty sockets and uncommitted edits do not count.
